 Steph Curry’s post after wife Ayesha’s viral kissing scene speaks volumes 
 By 
 Grant Young 
 Published 
 Nov. 5, 2026, 5:16 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make California Post a Preferred Source 
 Steph Curry is usually the family member who is performing in front of cameras.
 But it was Steph’s wife, Ayesha, who took center stage on Thursday, as the Roku original movie she stars in called “Second Chance Holiday ” was released.
 3 
 Ayesha Curry kissing her co-star, Matthew Daddario, in Roku’s “Second Chance Holiday” movie. (X/@BBallGround). 
 The most viral moment from the movie probably isn’t what Steph or Ayesha were hoping for. It was a scene in which she kisses her co-star, Matthew Daddario, that blew up on social media, to the point where Ayesha had to address the kissing scene with an X post that read, “ It’s not even real 🤣 you guys are annoying.”
 Steph has shown Ayesha nothing but support for landing this leading role, and he surely knew about what her taking the job would entail.
 And the first post he made after this kissing scene went viral proves that he is still unbothered.

 3 
 Steph Curry of the Golden State Warriors looks on during a game against the Minnesota Timberwolves at Target Center in Minneapolis on Oct. 28, 2026. NBAE via Getty Images 
 Ayesha made an Instagram post promoting that movie that was captioned, “ Today’s the day! Stream “Second Chance Holiday” on the @therokuchannel . So grateful!!!”
 The Warriors superstar reposted his wife’s post to his own Instagram Story and added the song “Feeling Good” by Nina Simone over it.
 3 
 Steph Curry’s Instagram post sharing his wife Ayesha’s “Second Chance Holiday” promotional post. (Instagram/@stephencurry30). 
 Props to Steph if he is indeed feeling good after seeing his wife on the big screen.
